int parent[MAX_N], parent_edge[MAX_N], in_queue[MAX_N];

int source = MAX_N - 2;
int sink = MAX_N - 1;

int remaining(int idx) {
    return edges[idx].capacity - edges[idx].flow;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
        dist[i] = INF;
        parent[i] = -1;
        parent_edge[i] = -1;
        in_queue[i] = 0;
    }
    dist[source] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(source);
    in_queue[source] = 1;

        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        in_queue[u] = 0;

                }
            }
        }
    }
    int current = sink;

        edges[parent_edge[current]].flow++;

        add_edge(i * n, sink, k, i * c);

        int x, y; cin >> x >> y; --x; --y;
